selected_for_rules.rejected_descriptively: us100 spill-over (<= 0.9 bp after the minute, 1.1-2.0 bp inside the non-tradable same minute), NY-open momentum (<= 1.1 bp), fix momentum into the fix (<= 0.5 bp all days), fix reversal on all days (<= 0.8 bp), US-afternoon leg except eurjpy/eurusd (<= 1.0 bp), Asia-window drift (opposite of the 'own region' hypothesis for JPY/AUD/NZD, <= 1.7 bp)

common: market entry at the open of the first M1 bar at/after the decision time (skip if > 5 min late); stop = stop_atr x ATR24 of H1 mid bars (mean true range of the last 24 complete hourly bars) from the fill; market time exit; weekdays; one position per pair

params.entry: stop at range high/low, first touch only
